title: Chess game with Gaddafi on Russia Day

tellings.quote: was nowhere to be seen. And then I arrived. It was the 12th of June, Russia day.

plain: The former president of a republic within Russia told podcast host Jesse Michels that on 12 June 2011, Russia Day, he went to Tripoli, the capital of Libya, and played a game of chess with Muammar Gaddafi, the country's leader, who at first was nowhere to be seen. He tells it as part of his life story on a show where he also says he was taken by aliens in 1997.
